entities.summary: Richard Farda is a retired professional ice hockey player who played in the Czechoslovak Extraliga and World Hockey Association. He played for HC Brno, Toronto Toros, and Birmingham Bulls. He won a bronze medal at the 1972 Winter Olympics.
